summary: Iteration 11 — Equipment Pre-Op Inspection module fully validated. 119/119 backend pytest in 21.69s (102 carry-over + 17 new in test_equipment_inspections.py). Verified all requested coverage: GET /api/equipment-types returns exactly 23 types and 23 checklist templates (every type has >=4 sections each with >=1 item); POST /api/equipment-units saves and de-dups by (equipment_type, unit_label) returning the existing id; GET /api/equipment-units?equipment_type=Excavator filters correctly; POST /api/equipment-inspections persists the record AND auto-registers the equipment_unit in the dropdown (verified via follow-up GET /equipment-units showing the new unit_label); admin-gated GET /api/equipment-inspections (401 without X-Admin-Token, 200 with), GET /{id} (404 for missing), DELETE /{id} (then 404). PM auto-resolution verified: project_number 24-06 → David Jewett (davidjewett@mascigc.com) via find_pm_for_record + recipients_for_record. WeasyPrint render_record_pdf('equipment-inspection', record) returns valid PDF bytes (>1KB, %PDF magic) for both pass and fail cases; FAIL/DO-NOT-OPERATE/OUT-OF-SERVICE banner text present in HTML body when fail_count>0. Subject-prefix logic 'EQUIPMENT FAIL · ' triggers only when kind=='equipment-inspection' AND fail_count>0. KIND_TITLES['equipment-inspection']='Equipment Pre-Op Inspection'. All test records DELETEd in the same suite — clean.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/equipment-inspections (line 829) calls create_equipment_unit via direct fn invocation; this is fine but bypasses HTTP-layer validation. Acceptable — same pattern used elsewhere and wrapped in try/except.
server.py POST /api/equipment-units returns the existing record on de-dup with status 200, not 201/200 distinction. Documented behavior per spec (1a). Frontend can rely on response shape regardless.

checklists.py EQUIPMENT_TYPES list and CHECKLISTS dict keys match 1:1 (23/23) — verified. 'Telehandler / Forklift' and 'Shuttle Buggy / Transfer Machine' use the literal strings with surrounding spaces around the slash; frontend dropdowns must POST the exact same string or checklist lookup will miss. Recommend adding a startup sanity-check assert(set(EQUIPMENT_TYPES)==set(CHECKLISTS.keys())) in checklists.py to fail fast if a future edit drifts.
pdf_render._render_equipment renders FAIL banner when fail_count>0 — verified via HTML inspection. Banner text 'OUT OF SERVICE' / 'DO NOT OPERATE' / 'FAIL' appears as expected.

Auto-email pipeline (schedule_auto_email + _dispatch_auto_email) reuses the existing fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task pattern with broad try/except — equipment-inspection rides on the same path as the other 5 modules. EQUIPMENT FAIL prefix logic at server.py:1126-1131 verified by mirror-test.
